metric_definitions.limitation: Owned-video playbacks across contexts, not strictly in the playlist
Owned-video minutes across contexts, not strictly in the playlist
In-playlist video views including videos owned by other channels
Minutes watched within a playlist context
Seconds per video view, not a duration per playlist visit
Starts counted only when playlist playback begins on the web
Video views per web playlist initiation, not a series-completion percentage
Estimated minutes after web playlist initiation
Net saved playlist change, not unique subscribers

warnings: Owner aggregate views and watch minutes are for channel-owned videos and may include non-playlist contexts.
In-playlist metrics can include videos owned by other channels.
playlistStarts, viewsPerPlaylistStart and averageTimeInPlaylist are web-only measures.
Playlist initiations and video view events are not deduplicated people.
Views per playlist start is not episode completion, repeat-person retention, or sales conversion.
No private owner analytics, repeat viewer cohorts, actual payout or series completion were measured.
